name: takegraph
description: Agent-native, voice-first video editing with reviewable patches.

scripts.build: pnpm build:view && pnpm build:mcp && cargo build --workspace
scripts.check: pnpm -r check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.spec:change-set: node scripts/run-quint.mjs typecheck --group=change-set && node scripts/run-quint.mjs run --group=change-set
scripts.spec:edit-contracts: node scripts/run-quint.mjs typecheck --group=edit-contracts && node scripts/run-quint.mjs run --group=edit-contracts
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && cargo build -p takegraph-cli && pnpm build:view && pnpm build:mcp && pnpm -r test && pnpm test:bridge
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm spec:typecheck && pnpm spec:run
